data.name: Bridgette
data.gender_notes: Bridgette is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Brighid, the Irish goddess of poetry, fertility, and healing. The name Bridgette is a feminine form of the Irish name Bríd or Bride. The name Bridgette carries the meaning “Exalted one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Bridgette usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Bridgette belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bridgette total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: בריגדט
in_hebrew.meaning: אלוהים הוא שגodet ברית Gott mit uns
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם בריגדט מקורו בשם העברי בריגית, שפירושו 'אלוהים הוא שגodet ברית Gott mit uns'. השם נגזר מהמילים 'בר' ו'גדת', שפירושם 'אלוהים הוא אדון הבית'. השם בריגדט משויך לנצרות ולמסורת הנוצרית, ומשמעותו היא 'אלוהים הוא שגodet ברית Gott mit uns', והוא מייצג את הקשר בין האדם לאלוהים.

in_greek.name: Μπριτζέτ
in_greek.long_meaning: Τὸ ὄνομα Μπριτζέτ προέρχεται ἀπὸ τὸ ἑβραϊκὸ ὄνομα Μְרִיגַת, ποῦ σημαίνει 'Θεός ἐστιν ἡ ἐξαιρετική μου'. Τὸ ὄνομα Μπριτζέτ ἦταν γνωστό στὴν ἀρχαία Ἑλλάδα καὶ συνδέεται μὲ τὴν χριστιανικὴ παράδοση. Ἡ λέξη Μπριτζέτ εἶναι ἡ ἑλληνικὴ μορφή τοῦ ονόματος, ποῦ σημαίνει 'Θεός ἐστιν ἡ ἐξαιρετική μου'.

in_latin.name: Bridgette
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Bridgette originem habet in nomine hebraico Mərīgath, quod significat 'Deus est mea excellentia'. Nomen Bridgette in traditione christiana et ecclesia primitiva in usu erat. Vox Bridgette Latina forma nominis est, quae significat 'Deus est mea excellentia'.

in_english.name: Bridgette
in_english.meaning: Exalted one, God is my strength
in_english.long_meaning: The name Bridgette originates from the Hebrew name Mərīgath, meaning 'exalted one' or 'God is my strength'. The name Bridgette has been adopted into Christian tradition and is associated with Saint Bridget of Sweden, a 14th-century mystic and founder of the Bridgettine Order. The name symbolizes spiritual strength, devotion, and a strong connection to God. In modern usage, Bridgette remains a popular name across Christian cultures, representing a strong and pious individual.

data.cultural_impact: The name Bridgette is a popular one among the Irish diaspora and has been adopted by Christians worldwide. In Irish mythology, Brighid was believed to possess magical healing powers and was also the patron saint of poets and scholars. This rich cultural heritage continues to influence the perception and meaning of the name Bridgette. It carries a deep connection to the Celtic past and the lush, mystical landscape of Ireland.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name Bridgette represents faith, hope, and the power of divine intervention. Named after the Irish goddess of healing, Bridgette embodies the spirit of healing and hope. It also pays homage to the poetic and scholarly aspects of the goddess Brighid, suggesting creativity, intelligence, and a love for learning. The name Bridgette can be a powerful reminder of the power of spirituality and the strength it can bring to one's life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Bridgette is derived from the Irish name Brighid, meaning "exalted one," "strong one," or "goddess of fire." In Christian tradition, St. Bridgette is revered as a patroness of fertility and marriage, representing the spiritual fire of God's love that brings new life and growth.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Bridget of Kildare (d. 525) was an Irish saint and abbess. The name Bridgette carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Bridget was the founder and abbess of the monastery at Kildare, Ireland. She was known for her piety and miracles. Bridget is the patron saint of Ireland and is venerated in the Roman Catholic Church.

trends: Bridgette is a modern variant of the name Bridget
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Bridgette remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.
